contrasts.loss_scope: petals_chemically_assayed; vegetative pigment loss not established

contrasts.biological_replication: 5 biological replicates for petal chemistry and qPCR; cultivar identities not independent evolutionary origins
contrasts.morph_contrast: Vintage White/Iron White/White Wonder No.2/Quartet White versus Vintage Lavender
contrasts.identified_variants: shared one-base deletion at ANS coding position 486 (ans-1)
contrasts.claim_ceiling: Sequence-defined predicted truncation with cultivar association; no allele rescue. Four cultivars are not four independently evolved mutations.
